grammar.0.title: dass clause: verb at the end
grammar.0.text: dass = “that” (a conjunction). After the main clause comes a comma, then dass + the rest, with the verb at the end. The comma is compulsory.
grammar.1.title: Which words are followed by dass?
grammar.1.note: You can also leave dass out: „Ich finde, Sport ist wichtig“ — then the verb is in second place (a normal sentence).
grammar.2.title: das or dass?
grammar.2.note: The two can stand side by side: „…, dass das gesund ist“. Here dass is the conjunction and das is the pronoun.
